body:
## Scope and decisions considered
Reviewed the frozen change to the display-label boundary and its sole consumer. The change is limited to trimming the value returned for rendered profile labels; stored identifiers and source profile values remain untouched.

## Evidence and findings
No correctness findings. `renderProfile` passes only `profile.displayName` to `displayName`, and the changed implementation returns `String(value).trim()` without mutating the profile. The focused test asserts both the trimmed rendered value and preservation of `id` and the original `displayName`. The prepared policy summary reports the exact-head required CI check successful and the merge state clean.

## Verification limitations
I did not execute commands in this review environment. The configured local verification command is `npm test`; exact-head CI is reported successful by the prepared policy evidence. Review was based on the frozen diff and relevant consumers/tests.

## Recommendation
APPROVE. The implementation matches the stated presentation-boundary behavior and preserves source data and identifiers.
